name: Bump switch (lever micro switch, KW12-3)
description: Lever micro switch for robot bumpers and end stops: pressing the lever connects COM to NO and opens NC. Wire COM to GND and NO to a pin set to INPUT_PULLUP: it reads LOW while bumped. On a robot in a world, the physics presses it when the robot touches something on the side set by mount.

pins.label: NO
pins.description: Normally open: connected to COM only while the lever is pressed. Usually to an INPUT_PULLUP pin.

pins.label: NC
pins.description: Normally closed: connected to COM while the lever is free.

props.label: Mounted on
props.description: Where it sits on the robot. A robot world presses it when the body touches a wall or obstacle within 1 cm on that side; without a world it only changes with press / release.

footprint: KW12-3 / SS-5GL style micro switch, 20 × 10 × 6.4 mm body, hinge lever, 3 solder tabs

bindings.description: True while the lever is pressed (COM–NO closed).
Which contact COM is on: "NO" (pressed) or "NC" (free).
